trap.label: present perfect continuous (produção)
trap.wrong: We are planning a trip since March and I am saving money for six months.
trap.right: We have been planning a trip since March and I have been saving money for six months.
trap.why: Em português usamos o presente (“planejamos desde março”). Em inglês, ação em andamento desde o passado pede have been + -ing com for/since.

fix.right: I have been saving since January.

fix.wrong: We have been plan a trip.
fix.right: We have been planning a trip.

fix.wrong: He has been work for three hours.
fix.right: He has been working for three hours.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I plan a trip. It started in May.” (since)
rewrite.answer: I have been planning a trip since May.
How long has she been studying?

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva na negativa: “I have been saving money.”
